_what: Mycelium Munchies, level B2 of Arlesglad Caverns: a mushroom farm with a restaurant at the end of the growing rooms. Ryan's brief, 2026-09-26: all kinds of mushrooms, served all kinds of ways, with three house specialities named in it -- crispy fried oyster mushrooms, lion's mane nuggets and mushroom steaks. Everything here is written by tools/make-mycelium.py into the room: the specialities on the pass, the rest of the menu, and the growing rooms.
_grown_here: EVERYTHING ON A PLATE WAS GROWN ON THE SHELVES YOU WALK PAST TO GET TO THE PASS. The tool refuses a dish with a mushroom the growing rooms do not grow, and a mushroom the rooms grow that no dish serves, because 'all kinds of mushrooms, served all kinds of ways' is the brief and a mushroom on a shelf that never reaches a plate is a decoration pretending to be a crop.
_no_latin: NO MUSHROOM IS NAMED TO SPECIES, the herbarium's rule. A Latin name on a menu reads as a determination and was typed from memory, which is the fabrication this site argues against in the format most likely to be believed. They are named the way a kitchen names them. The tool refuses a short list of genera anywhere in this file or the room, and a name shaped like a binomial.
_not_a_field_guide: NOTHING HERE HELPS ANYBODY IDENTIFY A WILD MUSHROOM. That is the most dangerous friendly edit anywhere on the street: a sentence about what a mushroom looks like, next to a sentence about where it grows, is one step from somebody eating something they found. So every mushroom's look is written as it looks on this farm's shelves, every one was grown here, and the tool refuses the vocabulary of foraging and identification, with the negation window so the room can say that it will not.
_not_a_supplement: A MUSHROOM HERE IS DINNER. Lion's mane is sold everywhere as a brain booster, and on a site built by and for neurodivergent people a menu promising a better brain is the cure framing on a plate. No dish is for your brain, your nerves, your immune system or your energy, and the tool refuses the vocabulary. Nor is anything here 'magic': the farm grows food.
_not_the_wood_wide_web: Our own post on the mycelial worldview is the reason the room exists, and the room quotes one line of ours from it about composting, which is not in dispute. It does not state that forests talk through their fungi or that trees feed their young through them: those claims are argued about among the people who study them, and a menu is not the place to settle it. The tool refuses the phrase.
_in_it: EVERY DISH SAYS WHAT IS IN IT BEFORE YOU ORDER, the street's runtime rule for a kitchen: a person who cannot eat something should not have to ask. The tool refuses a dish without its `in`. NOTHING IS SERVED RAW, and the tool refuses a raw way.
_colour: Each mushroom's `colour` is one of the room's own inks in love.css: grey, pink, gold, blue, cream or tan. It paints a small cap beside the mushroom's name and nothing else, and the name is always in words beside it.

why.line: Composting is not destruction. It is how a commons renews itself.

mushrooms.name: Grey oyster mushroom
mushrooms.look: Soft grey fans growing in overlapping clusters out of the side of their bags, like little shelves.
mushrooms.cooked: Tender and a little chewy, and it tears into strips along its gills.

mushrooms.name: Pink oyster mushroom
mushrooms.look: Fans of a bright, almost unlikely pink, with frilled edges.
mushrooms.cooked: Chewier than the grey, and it goes a pale tan when it cooks, which surprises everybody once.

mushrooms.name: Golden oyster mushroom
mushrooms.look: Small yellow caps in tight bunches, like a bouquet somebody handed you.
mushrooms.cooked: Delicate and nutty, and it cooks in almost no time at all.

mushrooms.name: Blue oyster mushroom
mushrooms.look: Blue-grey caps when they are young, fading towards grey as they open out.
mushrooms.cooked: Firm enough to press flat under a weight and brown hard.

mushrooms.name: King oyster mushroom
mushrooms.look: A thick white stem as long as your hand with a small brown cap on top, so nearly all of it is stem.
mushrooms.cooked: Dense and meaty, and it holds its shape when it is cut into planks.

mushrooms.name: Lion's mane
mushrooms.look: A round white cluster of soft hanging spines, like a pom-pom or a waterfall that stopped.
mushrooms.cooked: Soft and stringy the way crab is, and it pulls apart into pieces.

mushrooms.name: Shiitake
mushrooms.look: Brown caps with pale flecks, on short tough stems that go into the broth rather than the pan.
mushrooms.cooked: Rich and savoury, and deeper again once it has been dried.
mushrooms.grown_on: blocks of hardwood sawdust, and logs

mushrooms.name: Maitake
mushrooms.look: A frilled grey-brown cluster of overlapping fronds, big enough to need both hands.
mushrooms.cooked: Crisp at the edges and tender in the middle when it is roasted whole.

mushrooms.name: Enoki
mushrooms.look: Long, thin white stems with tiny caps, packed tight in bundles.
mushrooms.cooked: Soft and slippery in a broth, and crisp at the tips on a grill.
mushrooms.grown_on: bottles, in the dark, which is why it comes out long, thin and white

mushrooms.name: Button mushroom
mushrooms.look: Small, smooth white caps, closed tight underneath.
mushrooms.cooked: Mild, and it takes on whatever it is cooked with.

mushrooms.name: Chestnut mushroom
mushrooms.look: The same kind of mushroom as the button, in a brown skin, with a firmer bite.
mushrooms.cooked: A little deeper in flavour than the white one.

mushrooms.name: Portobello
mushrooms.look: The chestnut mushroom again, left to grow until its cap opens as flat and wide as a saucer.
mushrooms.cooked: Deep, dark and juicy, and big enough to be a meal on its own.

dishes.name: Crispy fried oyster mushrooms
dishes.what: Oyster mushrooms torn into pieces along their own gills, coated and fried until the edges shatter.
dishes.in: Grey, pink and golden oyster mushrooms; flour, cornflour, salt, pepper and smoked paprika; fried in sunflower oil; a lemon and garlic dip on the side, made with oil and no egg.

dishes.name: Lion's mane nuggets
dishes.what: Lion's mane pulled into pieces the size of a bite, pressed, breaded and fried, soft all the way through.
dishes.in: Lion's mane; flour, oat milk and breadcrumbs; salt, garlic powder and onion powder; fried in sunflower oil; a mustard and maple dip.

dishes.name: Mushroom steaks
dishes.what: A king oyster cut into thick planks and scored, or a whole portobello cap, seared hard in a heavy pan and finished with the pan's own juices. Your pick of the two.
dishes.in: King oyster mushrooms or portobello caps; olive oil, garlic, thyme, soy sauce and black pepper; mashed potatoes and greens on the side.

dishes.name: Shiitake broth with noodles
dishes.what: A dark, clear broth made from dried and fresh shiitake, with noodles, and a nest of enoki dropped in at the end.
dishes.in: Shiitake, fresh and dried; enoki; wheat noodles; soy sauce, ginger, spring onion and sesame oil.

dishes.name: Roast maitake
dishes.what: A whole maitake cluster roasted until the frilled edges crisp and the middle stays tender, pulled apart at the table.
dishes.in: Maitake; olive oil, salt and lemon; a spoonful of miso butter made with plant butter.

dishes.name: Blue oyster tacos
dishes.what: Blue oyster mushrooms griddled flat under a weight until they brown, folded into warm tortillas.
dishes.in: Blue oyster mushrooms; corn tortillas; cumin, chilli, lime and salt; shredded cabbage and coriander.

dishes.name: Grilled enoki bundles
dishes.what: Bundles of enoki tied at the root end and grilled until the tips go crisp.
dishes.in: Enoki; soy sauce, maple syrup and garlic; a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Mushrooms on toast
dishes.what: Button and chestnut mushrooms cooked slowly in a wide pan until they give up their water and take colour, piled on toast.
dishes.in: Button and chestnut mushrooms; plant butter, garlic and parsley; sourdough toast.

dishes.name: Chestnut mushroom soup
dishes.what: A thick soup of chestnut mushrooms cooked down with onions and blended smooth.
dishes.in: Chestnut mushrooms; onion, garlic, potato, vegetable stock, thyme and oat cream.

dishes.name: Pink oyster crisps
dishes.what: Pink oyster mushrooms pressed thin and baked slowly until they snap, which is when they stop being pink.
dishes.in: Pink oyster mushrooms; olive oil, smoked salt and a little maple syrup.

dishes.name: Golden oyster stir-fry
dishes.what: Golden oyster mushrooms tossed fast in a very hot pan with greens, over rice.
dishes.in: Golden oyster mushrooms; pak choi, garlic, ginger and soy sauce; white rice.

dishes.name: Mushroom skewers
dishes.what: Chunks of king oyster, whole shiitake caps and button mushrooms on skewers, grilled and brushed as they go.
dishes.in: King oyster, shiitake and button mushrooms; olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, and a lemon to squeeze.
